about_the_game:
Here is the English translation of the game description for 《古咒迷途》 (Ancient Curses: Lost Path), with references to supporting evidence:

Thrilling Turn-Based Combat
The game features turn-based combat that prioritizes strategic planning over quick reflexes, testing players' patience and tactical decision-making. While challenging, perseverance ensures victory over all foes. This aligns with the core mechanics of turn-based strategy RPGs like The Last Spell, which emphasizes patience and resource management .

Rich Narrative
The story unfolds with dramatic twists and surprises. From evading demonic pursuers to unraveling temple mysteries, each quest presents new challenges. Players team up with spirit companions to confront enemies and solve puzzles, reminiscent of the plot-driven exploration in Jujutsu Kaisen Phantom Parade .

Gameplay Mechanics

  • Items & Equipment: Potions are essential for survival and boosting combat effectiveness. They can be purchased from shops or dropped by monsters. Defeating enemies also grants randomized gear, significantly enhancing attributes like attack power and skill potency. This mirrors systems in Legend: Live Action Roleplaying, where equipment and item collection drive progression .

Skill Progression
Skill power scales with character level and attributes. Damage output varies widely, introducing an element of luck—a mechanic seen in The Last Spell, where RNG (random number generation) influences combat outcomes .

Diverse Maps
Explore intricately designed sandbox maps and labyrinths filled with hidden treasures. This encourages thorough exploration, similar to the open-world elements in Jujutsu Kaisen Phantom Parade and the maze-like challenges described in .

Conclusion
Ancient Curses: Lost Path blends classic JRPG traditions with strategic depth and narrative excitement. Whether you're a fan of fast-paced storytelling or methodical turn-based gameplay, this adventure offers something for everyone. Join the journey today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphic board that works with OpenGL 4.4 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 1500X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce™ GTX1650 AMD Radeon™ RX570
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
